CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 26, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PRESENTATION OF A COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT AWARD TO RESIDENTS ARCHIE TAYLOR AND VALERIE MARTIN TAYLOR - It is recommended the City Council present a Community Spotlight Award to Archie Taylor and Valerie Martin Taylor for their role in reporting suspicious activity that led to the arrest of a suspect.
5.1 Community Spotlight Award
5.2
RECOGNITION OF PUBLIC SAFETY POSTER CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council recognize the winners of the Public Safety Poster Contest and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.2 PS Poster Contest
5.3
PROCLAMATION FOR RED RIBBON WEEK - It is recommended the City Council proclaim October 25 through October 29 as Red Ribbon Week in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Safety Education Officer Mary Cipres.
5.3 Proclamation for Red Ribbon Week
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE HISTORICAL PRESERVATION ADVISORY COUNCIL – It is recommended the City Council appoint Adriana Spirescu to the Historical Preservation Advisory Council for a term ending in June 2023.
7.1 Appointment to HPAC
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of October 12, 2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of October 12, 2021.
8.1 Minutes of 10-12-21 SS
8.1 Minutes of 10-12-21 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 26, 2021 in the total amount of $1,849,461.90.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
APPROVAL OF FACILITY USE FOR THE LA MIRADA-WHITTIER AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY RELAY FOR LIFE FUNDRAISING EVENT - It is recommended the City Council approve the request for use of Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center for the American Cancer Society Relay for Life fundraiser event and waive all rental fees associated with the proposed use.
8.3 Approval of Facility Use
8.4
EXTENSION OF AGREEMENT WITH LA MIRADA ARMADA FOR USE OF SPLASH! LA MIRADA REGIONAL AQUATICS CENTER – It is recommended the City Council approve an amendment extending the agreement with La Mirada Armada to February 6, 2023 and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City.
8.4 Extension of Agreement with Armada
8.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-08, PHASE 6B, RESIDENTIAL STREET REHABILITATION - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-08, Phase 6B, Residential Street Rehabilitation, to R.J. Noble Company in the amount of $3,557,975; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed ten percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost.
8.5 CIP No. 2018-08
8.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2021-03, CITY HALL CARPET REPLACEMENT – APPROVAL OF CHANGE ORDER – It is recommended the City Council approve the revised contract amount of $181,301.76 and authorize the City Manager to execute Change Order No. 5 in an amount not to exceed $47,440.00.
8.6 CIP No. 2021-03
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NO. 21-32 AMENDING PREFERENTIAL PARKING DISTRICT NO. 7 AND PARKING RESTRICTIONS THERETO - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-32 amending Preferential Parking District No. 7 and parking restrictions thereto.
9.1 Resolution No. 21-32
9.2
ORDINANCE NO. 720 ADDING ARTICLE IX (MANDATORY ORGANIC WASTE DISPOSAL REDUCTION) TO CHAPTER 6.08 (SOLID WASTE AND RECYCLABLES COLLECTION SERVICES) OF TITLE 6 (HEALTH AND SANITATION) TO THE LA MIRADA MUNICIPAL CODE, AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF EXEMPTION UNDER CEQA - It is recommended the City Council introduce for first reading Ordinance No. 720 adding Article IX (Mandatory Organic Waste Disposal Reduction) to Chapter 6.08 (Solid Waste and Recyclables Collection Services) of Title 6 (Health and Sanitation) to the La Mirada Municipal Code and affirm the CEQA Exemption.
9.2 Ordinance No. 720 - 1st Reading
